name: Link
description: Anchor element with token-based color variants and accessibility-aware external link handling. Provides :focus-visible styling and distinct visited/hover states.

href.description: The URL the link points to.

external.description: When true, appends ' (opens in new tab)' to aria-label for screen reader users. Does NOT automatically set target='_blank' — callers must do that explicitly.

variant.description: Color variant. 'default' uses color-text-link tokens. 'subtle' uses color-text-subtle. 'inverse' uses color-text-inverse.

do: Always provide meaningful link text — avoid 'click here' or 'read more'
Use external=true when the link opens content outside the current application
Set target='_blank' explicitly alongside external=true when you want the link to open in a new tab
Use variant='inverse' for links placed on dark or coloured backgrounds
doNot: Do not rely on external prop alone to open a new tab — set target='_blank' separately
Do not use Link for actions — use a Button instead
Do not suppress the visited state for navigation links

accessibility.notes: The external prop appends ' (opens in new tab)' to the aria-label so screen reader users are informed before activating the link. :focus-visible outline uses var(--color-border-focus) to meet WCAG 2.4.11 focus appearance criteria. Visited state is preserved via color-text-link-visited token.
